verdict.rationale: Persona's own docs confirm it verifies government-issued IDs through a dedicated Government ID Verification. Nothing in the pack shows how many countries or which document types are supported, and no supported list is published. Missing for 10: a published supported-countries list, an enumeration of document types (passports, national IDs, driver licenses, residence permits), and independent corroboration of coverage breadth.

support.subject: As an ops lead, the platform verifies government IDs from a documented breadth of countries and document types — passports, national IDs, driver licenses, residence permits — with the supported list published

citations.quote: Perform identity verification using government-issued IDs, liveness checks, and database lookups.
A Government Id Verification answers the question "Does the individual possess a genuine Government Issued Identity that supports their claim to a physical identity?"
